Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Acme Speech is hiring a senior machine learning engineer to own speech recognition quality. You will fine-tune Whisper, build evaluation tooling and ship low-latency inference. Python and PyTorch required. Remote within Europe.

You will join a team of six engineers, work directly with the founders and review recognition quality weekly. We publish internal benchmarks, treat evaluation data as a product and meet in Nairobi twice a year. Benefits include a learning budget, four weeks of paid leave and remote-first work within East Africa.
